note: The controlling 2005 Compendium and the independently produced 1910 Raccolta agree on all 17 substantive words, their order and the short prayer boundary. Stress marks, punctuation, capitalization and lineation are accidentals under substantive-only comparison. The 1952 Enchiridion witness adds hodie (vel hac nocte) after superna; because this materially specifies the time and presents an alternate night form, it is recorded as a distinct longer variant and not conflated with the selected short recension.
